avis.texte: Unfortunately, this was a big disappointment for me. Not really the best selection of shades. I am pale but shade Fair is way too light an shade Medium is way too dark. It piles under my eyes and dries undereye area like crazy, almost like a rash! And it unfortunately creases too. I am sorry but I wouldn't recommend this. Too hyped! For reference I have a fale combination skin with a little dark under eyes circles
it's really dry and creases like crazy, I thought the texture would be a good thing bc creamy concealers tend to crease a little bit on me but it was just worse

avis.titre: Too hyped up and not enough product development
avis.texte: I have hereditary dark circles and have seen so many ads showing what this product does on other people. Sadly, it did nothing for me. The application is nice but the product didn't conceal or even brighten my undereye at all. It pilled under makeup and created a dry rash on my entire eye area.

I have acne-prone skin that's also very combination. I use sunscreen daily, and wanted a concealer that could hold up and layer well with my other skincare without looking like a mask. I've tried every concealer at every price point and can confirm that the DRMTLGY eye corrector is the only one I will ever buy from now on. The coverage is flawless, and yet it's completely seamless on my skin. I don't wear foundation and you can't tell where the concealer ends and my skin begins. It doesn't crease or smudge. It doesn't settle. It doesn't look freaking scary up close. I'm so, so thoroughly pleased with this stuff. I have a neutral-olive skin tone and somehow the color just WORKS. That alone would keep me coming back for more, but this stuff just checks every box!!

I checked this product out in store and used the tester and was instantly impressed that it acts like a light concealer but the luminous really stands out. It's not heavy and blended in perfectly. It's kind of dummy proof! I really prefer this over concealer on 55+ yr old eyes - looks natural and not cakey at all. Lightweight formula.

avis.titre: This Product is the Best I've Tried for Under Eye Circles
avis.texte: So far out of all the under eye dark circle correctors I've tried this one does the best at almost making them disappear. The extra bonus with this one is the spf of 41. It's very difficult to find an undereye concealer that has that type of protection. I do find that it's best to use a little under eye cream before applying this product. It goes on very smooth with a little bit of added moisture. I'll be purchasing this again in the future.
Love this! Color corrector and concealer, great coverage, non drying

Unfortunately it caused my skin to not only dry out far more than anything i've ever experienced, but additionally, it caused my undereyes swell up, turn bright red and become incredibly itchy/painful. The coverage seemed nice but this product does not seem to work for me with my current skincare routine/allergies
This is a good product for eye concealing with SPF it has good coverage.

I purchased this product after a few recommendations and my family told me I look like I got punched in both my eyes (black eyes)… thanks family. So eye corrector I got, to see if I can hide my genetic dark circle under eye issue. I use it. It lightened my under eye. Sometimes I can see under eye wrinkles from it and sometimes it is on point. I use it before I dab on my liquid foundation. My family told me my face looks better so I guess the eye corrector works. Oh! When I first took it out of the package the spring in it was lose or bent but I was able to fix it. But it is fragile! Maybe the company can help design a more durable container for it.
I was looking forward to this working. But sadly it doesn't do anything. I layered it the other day it helped a tiny bit. I then put my concealer on top.
This Corrector is perfect for the discoloration and under eye puffiness
Absolutely love this product easy to carry in your purse and works beautifully!
You only need a few dots of this product. It covers well, but it sticky or tacky even hours later. It takes some time to get used to blending it in.
Touted as a corrector for dark undereyes, and yet it didn't correct nor have the coverage that has been raved about. I returned it.

avis.titre: One of the best purchases I've made!
avis.texte: Before this product, I didn't use under eye concealer and I'm a millennial, so I'll let you figure out the math. This has been a game changer for me as my teenage son used to tell me how tired I look, and now asks what I've done differently 10/10!
Kept tapping more and more on but the purple under my eyes still showed through. Was nice and creamy but coverage not enough.

It gives little coverage and actually doesn't burn my eyes. However, it looks dry on my upper and lower eyes no matter how much I hydrate them. But I have eczema and it doesn't irritate me. So I'd highly recommend this product for spf around eyes with woman who have eczema
I have dark (heredity) under eye circles. This color corrector does a great job.

Very nice concealer! Not heavy or thick. Covers nicely. Blends very well. Need just the tiniest amount which is actually possible to get out of applicator do u dont waste product. This tube will last a very long time. Highly recommend.
Great under eye color corrector! Tiny bit dry but i use kiels avocado under eye cream first, then apply this and that seems to help. Also a great coverage for any dark spots plus the spf is awesome!

I love this eye concealer/corrector! It blends very smoothly with NO pilling which is a problem with every other product I have tried. It looks natural and covers under eye discoloration and brightens my eyes . As a plus it has sunscreen!
This product does not work. I see no difference than a regular concealer. So disappointed. Will be returning.

The product is basically like putting a layer of concealer under your eye but with the skincare benefits! It never cakes up, it applies so smooth, it actually covers dark circles, and literally lasts all day long! I'm obsessed with this product, and the price is great considering how expensive other products are that don't even work as well.

Loved this! I have always had genetic hollow eyes and dark circles along with light skin. No, it doesn't make them invisible but much better. I use a tiny bit of concealer on top. I purchased this in medium and also bought the universal tinted sunscreen. Sunscreen's tint is cool toned and a little dewy. I add a bit of concealer too. Plan on repurchasing both. NJB

I wanted to love this sooooo much but I can't. It goes on smooth but dries and looks patchy and flaky. I make sure I moisturize with an eye balm under my eye so it's not dry and I pat with my fingers, sponge, brush and still don't get a good outcome.

All the hype DID NOT add up readers! Bought this with high hopes! Coverage is meh. Caked into creases. One pump is actually too much for both eyes but there's really no way to pump less because the way the applicator works so you are gonna run through it quicker. Pricey. Overall I was sad. Only positive was the color match. It was perfect. Honestly the Tarte Concealer is a much better buy for the money and much better coverage. When Ive used this one up i will go back to it. Boo DRMTLGY!!

Its fine as a concealer, nice it has spf but its nothing magical. Doesnt do anything for pigment or bags or hollows. The fair is too light and medium is a little too dark. The pump dispenses too much and the applicator just smears it around, doesnt really blend it. Save some money and just get the ulta brand concealer.

I will keep using this because it has SPF, but the dispenser produces too much of the product, which is wasteful and tends to make me want to use it in more parts of my face and then commit to more of a makeup look than I typically do.

avis.titre: I would buy this product again
avis.texte: Like the texture of the product, not too thick and goes on smooth. I use before I put on my concealer. Definitely fades the dark circles. Only negative is a lot comes out of the tube when you pump it.

I like the color and it matches my skin tone well, however it diesnt cover or eliminate dark circles like it claims. Glorified concealer with lighter coverage. Been using this for about two months now and haven't noticed a difference in my under eye area. Will not be repurchasing.
I have used this morning and evening for over a month, and I see no results whatsoever. This was a total waste of money. I will not purchase again.
This item is great for disguising bags and dark circles. I also love that it has spf in it. Love the double duty.
Unfortunately, this item isn't that it's all cracked up to be. It's really greasy feeling. It left creases and it doesn't blend well. I think i'll just stick with tarte concealer.

avis.titre: so good for the sensitive girlies!
avis.texte: Oh my goodness I loooove this product! I've always seen it advertised online but I HATE buying things I can't try! So when ulta finally sold these in store I tried it out and I LOVE it! I have eczema prone skin so the fact that I could use have this sit on my face all day and NOT have it irritate my skin was AMAZING!
This is the BEST concealer! At 67, I've tried quite a few. It doesn't settle in lines and lasts a long time. So happy it's available at Ulta.

avis.titre: I was a victim of marketing
avis.texte: This is nothing special, it most certainly will not replace your concealer. I have had dark circles my entire life, in addition to dry skin. I am fair so that's what I ordered, but its basically white. It looks more like a light-coverage highlight concealer than anything. It doesnt overly settle into lines, but again, no miracles here. If you touch it to blend too much it just comes off. I tried a concealer over it and it creased. Not impressed with this product.

I absolutely love how it feels. It feels cool- not sure if that's in the description. Feels lovely! Zero irritation to my sensitive eyes and a little goes far. My only critique would be that the lightest shade is very light and looks like the medium is very dark. I'm somewhat in the middle and would love to see that shade. It does not crease with a proper eye preparation with moisture and primer. This goes for all eye makeup. I would recommend this product!
I have dark under eyes and this product works. Definitely worth the money.
Too much product climbed out and was wasted and it did not really cover!

avis.titre: Is this as good as it seems?
avis.texte: If this does all the things it says it does, best purchase I have made in a long time. Love it! If it doesn't do what it says, it's still a great corrector/concealer.
This is great for an everyday minimal look! So easy to put on. Doesn't dry my skin.

Had my eye on this for a long while form all the FB ads; finally purchased it when I saw it in store and it's terrible. It makes my under-eye area look very dry and brings out fine lines I didn't even know I had.

avis.titre: A little goes a long way
avis.texte: I like the sheerness of this and the wand is cooling but I usually have to dab 70% of it off with damp sponge because even a tiny bit can be too much.

avis.titre: A little bit goes a long way!
avis.texte: Ive been using this daily and i love it! Its very brightening and a lightweight formula! The color range is great too! I like to let it dry completely under my eyes before applying foundation.

avis.titre: Such a great new eye corrector
avis.texte: I will certainly buy this incredible eye corrector again to help with my dark circles. Remember to use just half a pump since it goes a long way.

avis.titre: The only thing that works & doesn't dry out my under eye
avis.texte: Best undereye concealer I've tried thus far. This doesn't dry out or cake like other brands. The applicator is nice as well. Product is very thick so a little goes a long way. The spf is an added bonus! Definitely pleased with the bang for my buck.

I'm not an internet buying person but when I saw this in Ulta store I decided to try. The sales person was extremely knowledgeable and polite. After using it about 3 times my skin became very irritated and sensitive. Sadly I returned to Ulta without any problems

I love this concealer. I have aging undereyes and can no long use my tried a true concealers without it either settling into my lines or aging me 10 years and looking cakey. This stuff does the trick. It does take a few minutes to dry down, but its the only concealer I can wear that actively improves the look of my under eyes. That said, the packaging is terrible. Instead of a doe foot or squeeze tip, its a clicker that you push down and it releases a set amount of product, which almost always results in way too much- even for both under eyes. I have to cautiously half-click it, and even then, find myself having to blend forever or waste some of product because its just too much. Overall love it, but would love it even more if I had more control over the amount that came out.

avis.titre: It does not work like they claim it works, disappointed
avis.texte: This product is not what they claim it does. It was disappointing. I would not purchase it again.

avis.titre: I would buy this product again!
avis.texte: This under eye product is working for me. It is just the right consistency.
This eye corrector/concealer is the best I've ever purchased! It really diminishes dark circles and brightens the undereye area.

This corrector has officially replaced my concealer. It truly helps brighten the dark circles under my eyes and covers any dark spots effortlessly. It's my all‑time everyday go to! super lightweight, blends like a dream, and leaves my skin looking flawless with a natural glow. The perfect skincare meets makeup combo.

I've been buying this brand for years! I have sensitive combination skin that doesn't like most products. I have used this corrector as an all over concealer, under eye concealer and everything in between. It's light, medium/full coverage and lasts for a long time!
Smooth and great coverage without creasing or making you look older. Sensitive skin with no problems, powdered foundation looks great over the top.

avis.titre: I would buy this product again.
avis.texte: Good coverage. Lightweight and easy to apply. Do not need much to cover under eye area.

avis.titre: Amazing! Best concealer I've ever tried
avis.texte: It is really good! Cant even see it. Felt like i looked refreshed. Not cakey or dry looking. I have high hioes for it after testing it out at the store.

avis.titre: Not for Mature Skin w/Fine Lines
avis.texte: I am 47 years old - it creased so badly - immediately and settled into my fine lines. I did all the right things and different ways. So disappointed. I will be returning this product. I love the the tinted moisturizer, thought this would be great. Unfortunately, no.
Love product but hate wasting product and getting too much everytime you press to dispense

I tested this after i checked out while waiting on my daughter and OMG! On any given day, i look like i havent slept at all and this covered it right up!! It doesnt give off a "white washed" look, it blends so nicely and made me look like I have had a good nights rest since birth! Just for context, I'm 41 with 2 children (8 and 12) so if you know, you know! I will most definitely be ordering this ASAP
This product works great and lasts all day! Highly recommend!

As I am coming to terms with aging, my undereye area can be a challenge for concealer. It can look dry and patchy. I ended up trying this concealer after seeing it recommended by a dermatologist. It has SPF, it goes on very smooth, and provides great coverage. I don't notice it settling in my fine lines and it doesn't look cakey. It wears well for about 10 hours. I will throw caution if you travel with it, it does leak a little due to the cabin pressure. Other than that it's a great concealer.

I was fed multiple advertisements on this and then finally caved when I was desperate for a concealer upgrade. For my fair, combination, and 34 year old skin, it really is THAT good. It covers the darks, doesn't crease, cake, ball up, or anything else. It lasts and makes me look better than I feel throughout the day (I started wearing it when I went back to work after maternity leave so looking awake was super necessary). I have a super low skin care/makeup routine so I just put a full face primer/sunscreen with this and I'm good to go!

I have purchased this product a few weeks ago from Drmtlgy. I am 64 and honestly can say it is a great product to brighten the eye area. A little goes a long way and after putting on I first use the wand afterwards I pat it out. This is a must. As I have used Ilia products and others this one is worth the cost.

I've had dark circles since I was a teenager. They are from allergies and inherited. I've bought and tried so many products over the years. This is truly the only one that has ever really worked. I noticed a difference immediately. One easy application covers and corrects better than anything I've ever used. It's expensive but I no longer have to waste money on concealers that do not work. This is money well spent for me.
The instant I applied the Luminous Eye Concealer I knew I had found my holy grail! It covers, brightens and corrects all of my flaws, dark circles, puffiness and fine lines. Terrific product!
I have dark circles that I can't find anything to cover them. Although this doesn't completely lightens the whole eye area. It is the best I have found so far. The tube lasts a long time.
This definitely does lighten the under eye area. Goes on thick... just a little goes a long way. It's smooth not cakey. Love that there is spf protector in this! Will be keeping this in supply.

I've tried a lot of eye correctors from drugstore brands to more expensive brands and this is the best one I've tried hands down. It blends into my skin so it doesn't look like I used makeup under my eyes, but it also covers dark circles and signs of aging.

avis.titre: I am in love with this!
avis.texte: I have at least a dozen, and if I am being honest, closer to 20 eye products in my bathroom. This is the one I have been looking for. It is effective on dark circles, makes my puffy and crepe-y under eye area much better. Do not hesitate, put this in your cart.
Perfection= hydration, light-weight, no crease, & does what it says it will!! A definite staple in my daily morning routine!! You will LOVE it!!
I've been noticing more dark circles and this eye corrector is amazing!
I really like the luminous eye corrector. It helps my dark circles and doesn't accentuate my fine lines around my eyes. Make sure I'm using a lot of eye cream before. Looks very nice!
I'm 80 years old and my skin is not what it used to be, especially under and around my eyes. This skin corrector is a miracle worker. It truly covers my uneven skin tone and refreshes my whole face.

I (56F) worked at a cosmetics store for 8 years and have never been able to find a product that covers my dark under eye circles without getting cakey by the end of the day. This product hydrates and brightens, and doesn't cake even after hours of use. Friends have commented that my under eyes look better. I definitely recommend it!

This product was recommended to me for my darkened circles under my eyes and to use as a sunscreen. I'm loving it. It does not crease and the coverage is light weight but full coverage. will purchase again
I love this product! I use a small dot under my eyes and I'm good to go!
Love this product! I don't wear a lot of make up so this is just right Doesn't cake and stays smooth on eye area just makes eyes a little brighter.
I love this eye corrector so much!! A little goes a long way. Not sure what the difference is between a concealer and a corrector, but there is one! Love it!!

avis.titre: First product that does what it says
avis.texte: I generally do not do reviews but this product deserves one. All my life I have had a blue vein that is impossible to hide under my right eye. This is the first product that completely corrects this area with no creasing. This is officially in my arsenal.

avis.titre: Corrects Color without Settling into Wrinkles
avis.texte: Excellent color corrector for dark lines under eyes. My 56 year old skin around my eyes has shared many smiles resulting in many lines. This product helps with color (doesn't completely cover my dark lines, but does lighten them) and does not settle in my lines. Thankful I tried this!!
It really made a difference and blends so well. ISinc ethe eyes are the thinnest part of your face it's important to protect so I love this product

I've been using this concealer for over a year and love it! A little goes a long way with it. It is not drying nor does it "cake" in the lines around the eyes. I have extremely sensitive skin, including psoriasis around my eyes which is not bothered or inflamed by this product. I would definitely recommend this concealer.
Goes on easily. I love the applicator. Great coverage for dark circles.
A perfect hydratating concealer, the color is perfect, I have a very dry skin and it's just hydratating very well my underey
Thought I was being overly influenced but thought I give this a try after seeing so many before and after on women. Ordered this and WOW it's magical ! Get yours asap!

We've all tried just about everything out there for under eye concealer, corrector, call it what you will....but this item has solved all the mysteries, and I won't ever switch, I am serious, if you try it, you will love it!!!! I am on auto ship and during winter months use medium and summer months go with fair.... they always let you know when the next shipment is coming in case you want to change anything!

Been trying to find a replacement for my favorite discontinued Estée Lauder luminous concealer for 8 years. This one is pretty close! I was hesitant to buy without trying it but the SPF is what closed the deal for me. It is a little light in color for my skin tone, however overall I am happy with it and hope you will be too. One word of caution- when pressed the pump dispenses a large amount of concealer and it cannot be reversed. Press very lightly if you don't need much.

I have been using the corrector for a while. I had merkel cell skin cancer on my cheek...which has healed really well, and i use this corrector, it also helps to lighten the scar. I 100% recommend this product

Love that this undereye corrector not only makes my dark circles disappear but also provides 41 SPF all around the eyes... no more sunscreen tears! It applies easily, doesn't cake, plus a little goes a long way. I use it every day all year long.
This works like magic. It lightens and brightens the eye area!
It does as advertised. Another daily staple in my makeup bag!

I usually use a concealer for a little brightness but took a chance with the corrector , bought one for my daughter who deals with dark circles under her eyes naturally and it works very well. A little goes a long way. Thank you
My first time trying. I should have gone one shade darker and I wish I could have gotten samples of other products, but otherwise very good product.
I've bought this twice! Very light but great coverage and doesn't dry out.

For years I have battled with concealer caking under my eyes. I didn't have much expectations with this product. But WOW!!! It is an amazing product for under eye concealer/corrector. I will continue to use and never be without!
Just received this and am trying for the first time. I love it. It goes on easily and looks great!
It was a leap of faith to buy this without colour matching my skin in person and I am pleased with how it worked out. The coverage is flawless and the match is perfect. It's hydrating and smooth
I have tried a lot of concealers that does not work well for aging skin. I was pleasantly Surprised at how well this works.
I discovered this product through an add on Facebook. I bought it. I really fallin love with it. I buy it again and again. It becomes my favorite.
